source: National Archives Bill of Rights transcript, Amendment X
review_notes: Codex reviewed the complete Tenth Amendment sentence as one conditional reservation rule. The two negated clauses limit which powers the rule covers; they do not assert that every power is undelegated or unprohibited. The recipients remain a source-level disjunction, States respectively or people. These are Codex labels, not independent human labels.
text:
Amendment X

The powers not delegated to the United States by the Constitution, nor prohibited by it to the States, are reserved to the States respectively, or to the people.
